title: cli(dev): the watch opt-out the code checks for is unreachable — `watch` has no `allowNo`, so `--no-watch` is refused and `--watch=false` boots nothing and exits 0
body:
**What.** `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` declares `watch: Flags.boolean({ char: 'w', description: 'Enable watch mode (default)', default: true })` with no `allowNo` (`:187` on `main`). Three other flags in the same command do set `allowNo: true`. The code downstream expects an opt-out:
- `watchActive` is `flags.watch !== false && …` (`:383`);
- the comment above the watch-recompile loop lists "Skipped when: --watch=false (user opted out)" (`:699-700`).

No argv reaches that opt-out.

**Measured.** The #20649 dev (report on #20649, out-of-scope finding) ran `tsx bin/run-dev.js` at `17e3b7eadb`:
- `os dev --no-watch` answers "Nonexistent flag: --no-watch" and exits 2.
- `os dev --watch=false`, in a project directory, parses as `--watch` plus the positional PACKAGE `false`. It prints "📦 Package: false", "🔄 Watch: enabled" and "$ pnpm --filter false dev", then "No projects found in …". It exits 0 with nothing started.

`domain:spec` seat 5 re-read the flag declaration, the `package` positional (`:183`), `watchActive` and the comment on `main` at `6c11ef9ecb`. It did not re-run the CLI.

**Reach.** This is the public `objectstack dev` command. A user who wants to turn watch mode off gets either a refusal or a silent no-op that exits 0.

**Open.** Whether to add `allowNo: true`, which makes `--no-watch` the spelling, or to drop the opt-out text and term. This card does not choose.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`) from the #20649 dev report. It is unlabelled, for triage; the file is `packages/cli/**`.

Dedupe words: `dev watch flag allowNo no-watch` · `dev --watch=false package positional false` · `watchActive opt-out unreachable`
